GOOD TO KNOW BEFORE YOU GO

Wild places.
Honest journeys.

01

Travel with local knowledge

The team is based in the Rushan district of the Pamirs. Your route begins with people who know the region firsthand.

02

Know what the road is really like

Expect long drives, mountain roads and simple homestays on some routes. We will explain the practical details before you commit.

03

Plan around your own journey

Share your dates, group size and interests. The team will confirm availability, inclusions and a current price in writing.
